---
title: "Analyzing Music Data"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
#| message: false
```

```{r}
billboard_long <- billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "rank"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    week = parse_number(week),
    rank = as.numeric(rank),
    song_id = paste(artist, track, sep = " - ")
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(rank))

song_summary <- billboard_long |>
  group_by(artist, track, song_id) |>
  summarise(
    first_rank = first(rank),
    best_rank = min(rank),
    first_week_at_best_rank = min(week[rank == min(rank)]),
    total_weeks_on_chart = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(best_rank, first_rank)

notable_songs <- bind_rows(
  song_summary |>
    filter(best_rank == 1) |>
    arrange(first_week_at_best_rank) |>
    slice_head(n = 1) |>
    mutate(notable = "fastest to reach number one"),
  song_summary |>
    filter(best_rank == 1) |>
    arrange(desc(first_week_at_best_rank)) |>
    slice_head(n = 1) |>
    mutate(notable = "slowest to reach number one"),
  song_summary |>
    filter(best_rank <= 10) |>
    arrange(desc(total_weeks_on_chart)) |>
    slice_head(n = 1) |>
    mutate(notable = "top-10 song with longest chart run")
) |>
  mutate(song_id = paste(artist, track, sep = " - "))

highlighted <- notable_songs |>
  pull(song_id)

all_top_ten <- song_summary |>
  filter(best_rank <= 10) |>
  pull(song_id)

top10_long <- billboard_long |>
  filter(song_id %in% all_top_ten)

color_map <- c(
  "Madonna - Music" = "#d62728",
  "Lonestar - Amazed" = "#2ca02c",
  "Creed - Higher" = "#1f77b4"
)

ggplot(top10_long, aes(x = week, y = rank, group = song_id)) +
  geom_line(data = top10_long |> filter(!(song_id %in% highlighted)),
            color = "gray70", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_line(data = top10_long |> filter(song_id %in% highlighted),
            aes(color = song_id), linewidth = 1.1) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = color_map,
    breaks = names(color_map),
    labels = names(color_map)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Top-10 songs over time",
    x = "Week",
    y = "Rank",
    color = "Notable songs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())
```
